Physical_Environment.Location: Tsinghua University, Beijing, China (assumed from ethics approval and university recruitment; software to be confirmed)

Experimental_Design.Conditions: 3 (identity: general self, friend, stranger) x 2 (trial type: matching, nonmatching), within-subjects; 60 trials per condition (shape identity x trial type)

Block_Structure.Trial_number: 360 trials total per participant (60 per condition; randomized order across 6 blocks)
Block_Structure.Practice_trials: practice block with feedback until 6 consecutive correct responses (variable length); practice data not included in the shared files

Trial_Structure.SOA: 0 ms (simultaneous presentation; shape above, label below, 3.5 deg apart)
Trial_Structure.Stimulus_order: Simultaneous: fixation cross, then shape (2.4 x 2.4 deg) above and label (approx. 4.4 x 2.4 deg) below
Trial_Structure.Response_deadline: 1100 ms (blank screen after stimulus during which response was made; 'Too Slow' feedback otherwise)
Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: 500 ms (Correct / Incorrect / Too Slow after each trial)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: geometric shapes: circle, square, triangle (2.4 x 2.4 deg); identity binding counterbalanced across participants and not recorded in the shared files
Stimulus_Properties.Label: identity words: general self, friend, stranger (on-screen language/wording to be confirmed with authors)

exp2.detail: Experiment 2 of Zhao & Wang (2026, Psychon Bull Rev). Same procedure as Experiment 1 but identity labels were general self, friend, stranger (no true self), testing whether general self-prioritization emerges when the true self is absent. Response keys Z/M counterbalanced (not recorded; shared code response 1 = 'match' key, 0 = 'non-match' key). Data source: OSF https://osf.io/j2pxc/, file data/hddm_trial_data/exp2_hddm_trial_data.xlsx plus exp2_behavior_questionnaire.xlsx. Authors recruited 49 from a university, excluded 2 for below-chance accuracy, analysed 47 (29 female; Mage 23.21, SD 3.67); all 47 analysed participants present in the shared file (subject ids 1-48 minus id 14; id 49 unused). Shared trial file keeps only trials with a response and RT >= 200 ms (rows 16528 < 47 x 360 = 16920). Label identity recorded only on matching trials (equals shape identity by construction); 'missing' elsewhere. Questionnaires after the task (online): BTS, SCS, SEB. Ethics: Tsinghua University Ethics Committee THU-04-2025-1135. On-screen stimulus language/wording and presentation software to be confirmed with the authors.
